esc_period.description: Default operation step duration. Must be at least 60 seconds. Accepts seconds, time unit with suffix and user macro. Note that escalations are supported only for trigger, internal and service actions, and only in normal operations.

eventsource.description: (constant) Type of events that the action will handle. Refer to the event 'source' property on the event object page for a list of supported event types.

status.description: Whether the action is enabled or disabled. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

pause_suppressed.description: Whether to pause escalation during maintenance periods or not. Possible values: 0 - Don't pause escalation; 1 - (default) Pause escalation. Note that this parameter is valid for trigger actions only.

notify_if_canceled.description: Whether to notify when escalation is canceled. Possible values: 0 - Don't notify when escalation is canceled; 1 - (default) Notify when escalation is canceled. Note that this parameter is valid for trigger actions only.

filter.description: Action filter object for the action.

conditions.description: Set of filter conditions to use for filtering results.

conditiontype.description: Type of condition. Possible values for trigger actions: 0 - host group; 1 - host; 2 - trigger; 3 - event name; 4 - trigger severity; 6 - time period; 13 - host template; 16 - problem is suppressed; 25 - event tag; 26 - event tag value. Possible values for discovery actions: 7 - host IP; 8 - discovered service type; 9 - discovered service port; 10 - discovery status; 11 - uptime or downtime duration; 12 - received value; 18 - discovery rule; 19 - discovery check; 20 - proxy; 21 - discovery object. Possible values for autoregistration actions: 20 - proxy; 22 - host name; 24 - host metadata. Possible values for internal actions: 0 - host group; 1 - host; 13 - host template; 23 - event type; 25 - event tag; 26 - event tag value. Possible values for service actions: 25 - event tag; 26 - event tag value; 27 - service; 28 - service name.

value2.description: Secondary value to compare with. Required for trigger, internal and service actions when condition type is 26.

formulaid.description: Arbitrary unique ID that is used to reference the condition from a custom expression. Can only contain capital-case letters. Must be defined by the user when modifying filter conditions.

operator.description: Condition operator. Possible values: 0 - (default) equals; 1 - does not equal; 2 - contains; 3 - does not contain; 4 - in; 5 - is greater than or equals; 6 - is less than or equals; 7 - not in; 8 - matches; 9 - does not match; 10 - Yes; 11 - No.

evaltype.description: Filter condition evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - and/or; 1 - and; 2 - or; 3 - custom expression.

formula.description: User-defined expression to be used for evaluating conditions of filters with a custom expression. The expression must contain IDs that reference specific filter conditions by its formulaid: no condition can remain unused or omitted. Required for custom expression filters.

operations.description: Action operations to create for the action.

operationtype.description: Type of operation. Possible values: 0 - send message; 1 - global script; 2 - add host; 3 - remove host; 4 - add to host group; 5 - remove from host group; 6 - link to template; 7 - unlink from template; 8 - enable host; 9 - disable host; 10 - set host inventory mode. Note that only types '0' and '1' are supported for trigger and service actions, only '0' is supported for internal actions. All types are supported for discovery and autoregistration actions.

esc_period.description: Duration of an escalation step in seconds. Must be greater than 60 seconds. Accepts seconds, time unit with suffix and user macro. If set to 0 or 0s, the default action escalation period will be used. Default: 0s. Note that escalations are supported only for trigger, internal and service actions, and only in normal operations.

esc_step_from.description: Step to start escalation from. Default: 1. Note that escalations are supported only for trigger, internal and service actions, and only in normal operations.

esc_step_to.description: Step to end escalation at. Default: 1. Note that escalations are supported only for trigger, internal and service actions, and only in normal operations.

evaltype.description: Operation condition evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) AND / OR; 1 - AND; 2 - OR.

opcommand.description: Object containing data on global script run by the operation. Required for global script operations.

opcommand_grp.description: Host groups to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_hst is not set.

opcommand_hst.description: Host to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_grp is not set.

hostid.description: ID of the host; if set to 0 the command will be run on the current host.

opconditions.description: Operation conditions used for trigger actions.

conditiontype.description: Type of condition. Possible values: 14 - event acknowledged.

opgroup.description: Host groups to add hosts to. Required for "add to host group" and "remove from host group" operations.

opmessage.description: Object containing the data about the message sent by the operation. Required for message operations.

default_msg.description: Whether to use the default action message text and subject. Possible values: 0 - use the data from the operation; 1 - (default) use the data from the media type.

mediatypeid.description: ID of the media type that will be used to send the message.

opmessage_grp.description: User groups to send messages to. Required for message operations if opmessage_usr is not set.

opmessage_usr.description: Users to send messages to. Required for message operations if opmessage_grp is not set.

optemplate.description: Templates to link the hosts to. Required for "link to template" and "unlink from template" operations.

opinventory.description: Inventory mode set host to. Required for "Set host inventory mode" operations.

recovery_operations.description: Action recovery operations to create for the action.

operationtype.description: Type of operation. Possible values for trigger and service actions: 0 - send message; 1 - global script; 11 - notify all involved. Possible values for internal actions: 0 - send message; 11 - notify all involved.

opcommand.description: Object containing data on global action type script run by the operation. Required for global script operations.

scriptid.description: ID of the action type script.

opcommand_grp.description: Host groups to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_hst is not set.

opcommand_hst.description: Host to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_grp is not set.

hostid.description: ID of the host; if set to 0 the command will be run on the current host.

opmessage.description: Object containing the data about the message sent by the recovery operation. Required for message operations.

default_msg.description: Whether to use the default action message text and subject. Possible values: 0 - use the data from the operation; 1 - (default) use the data from the media type.

mediatypeid.description: ID of the media type that will be used to send the message.

opmessage_grp.description: User groups to send messages to. Required for message operations if opmessage_usr is not set.

opmessage_usr.description: Users to send messages to. Required for message operations if opmessage_grp is not set.

update_operations.description: Action update operations to create for the action.

operationtype.description: Type of operation. Possible values for trigger and service actions: 0 - send message; 1 - global script; 12 - notify all involved.

opcommand.description: Object containing data on global action type script run by the operation. Required for global script operations.

scriptid.description: ID of the action type script.

opcommand_grp.description: Host groups to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_hst is not set.

opcommand_hst.description: Host to run global scripts on. Required for global script operations if opcommand_grp is not set.

hostid.description: ID of the host; if set to 0 the command will be run on the current host.

opmessage.description: Object containing the data about the message sent by the update operation.

default_msg.description: Whether to use the default action message text and subject. Possible values: 0 - use the data from the operation; 1 - (default) use the data from the media type.

mediatypeid.description: ID of the media type that will be used to send the message.

opmessage_grp.description: User groups to send messages to. Required only for send message operations if opmessage_usr is not set. Is ignored for send update message operations.

opmessage_usr.description: Users to send messages to. Required only for send message operations if opmessage_grp is not set. Is ignored for send update message operations.
